sso.add.detail: In Gitea, create an OAuth2 application with the callback URLs below, then paste its client ID and secret here. The connector starts off, so you can test it before anyone uses it.

sso.add.title: Add a connector
sso.callbacks.none: An entrance is not served over HTTPS, so no provider can call it back.

sso.on.detail: People who linked their account can sign in with it, and the sign-in page offers it.
